description: Read an MEP identity or membership history: committee, delegation and political-group records. Default section overview returns identity, membership_count and membership_classifications (count per code); section memberships pages membership records, latest start_date first, filtered by classification and active_on before paging. Missing end dates do not establish current membership. Continue with page.next_offset and snapshot; after snapshot_changed, restart at offset 0 without it. Missing detail returns found false; euparl_search_meps discovers IDs.

active_on.description: Memberships only: keep memberships whose published interval includes this YYYY-MM-DD date, not after today (UTC), an absent end counting as open. A missing end date does not establish current membership.

classification.description: Memberships only: keep this membershipClassification code, bare (COMMITTEE_PARLIAMENTARY_STANDING) or as published (def/ep-entities/COMMITTEE_PARLIAMENTARY_STANDING), any case, matched on the last path segment. The overview lists the codes in membership_classifications; unclassified memberships never match.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Local collections return every requested row, with no output-size cap.

mep_id.description: Decimal person ID, person/ prefix or https://data.europarl.europa.eu/person/ URI.

section.description: Default overview returns identity and counts; memberships pages the history.

snapshot.description: Returned membership snapshot; required above offset 0.

name: euparl_get_mep

available.description: Whether the source array was published; a published empty array counts.

citizenship.description: Published citizenship; distinct from country of representation.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A person ID or language is unsupported, classification is not a code, or active_on is not a real date or is after today (UTC). `invalid_mode_fields`: Overview has a nonzero offset, classification or active_on, or continuation lacks a snapshot. `snapshot_changed`: The membership history changed since the supplied snapshot. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects the validated request. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limiting outlasts the retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

membership_classifications.description: Found overview only: classified memberships counted by code, sorted, the values classification accepts; unclassified ones are left out, so counts can sum below membership_count.

items.description: One classification code in this history.

classification.description: Classification code, the last path segment of the published value.

membership_count.description: Parsed membership count on a found overview; absent relations do not prove no membership history.

memberships.description: Memberships section page, latest start_date first, then by id, undated last; only when found.

end_date.description: Published interval end date; absence does not establish current membership.

organization_id.description: Organization ID, decimal (org/5154) or term code (org/ep-9); resolve with euparl_list_reference topic organizations and organization_ids.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

page.description: Membership page position; absent on overview or missing detail.

has_more.description: True when more matches exist or cannot be ruled out.

limit.description: Effective page size after caps and the search window.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page; absent at the search-window boundary even when has_more is true.

snapshot.description: Pass back with next_offset to continue this local collection.

place_of_birth.description: Published place of birth, never inferred from citizenship.

totalCount.description: Exact total; only when published or counted over the whole collection.

truncated.description: True when this page holds only part of the collection.

title: Read a member and membership history
